name: @story/multi-engine-server
comment:scripts: No build step and no `dist/` (REFACTOR_PLAN §7): the internal packages are consumed as TypeScript source, so the server runs them through `tsx`. `tsx` is declared here as well as at the root because Yarn 4 only puts a workspace's *own* dependencies' binaries on a script's PATH — without it `yarn workspace @story/multi-engine-server dev` (and the root `yarn dev`) answers `command not found: tsx`. Same as `Visualizer/server`.
comment:dependencies: Only what `src/index.ts` actually imports today. `@story/core` for `buildWorldState` and `@story/data` for the story register — the scaffold really does build this story's `TWorldState` at boot, which is the one piece of §3's "server owns TWorldState" that exists so far. Everything HTTP comes from `node:http`; there is deliberately no `ws` dependency (see the note in `src/index.ts`).
